unclaim flips the issue's state back to open on isu/<id> and pushes.

It does not delete the branch. A one-word command must not throw away work:
what it releases is the claim, and what it leaves is an ordinary branch the
board says nothing about.

Usage:
  isu unclaim <id> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for unclaim

Global Flags:
      --fetch         update remote refs before reading
      --json          print newline-delimited JSON instead of text
      --no-color      never colour the output
      --ref string    the ref isu treats as trunk (default: main, else master, else HEAD)
      --repo string   the repository to read (default: the working directory)
